newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks crawl lower in directionless trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks crawl lower in directionless trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks crawled lower in directionless trade on Wednesday morning, after trade data showing a leap in Japan's trade surplus did not move currencies greatly, brokers said. They said that the market was in a wait-and-see mood ahead of the G7 summit later this week.
As of 0121 GMT, the Nikkei average was down 158.32 points or 0.77 percent at 20,435.34. Its September futures slid 100 to 20,500.
"There are technical signs of strength in the stock market but profit-taking pressure is strong around 20,500 and gains are hard to collect," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
